about: Which VPS runner may sign a release launcher: release.yml's VPS fallback asks for this label beside thornswood-vps, so it runs on these runners and no other (#3312, Patrick, 22 Oct 2026: "for signing it will use runner 3"). Runner 3 is the light runner (docs/DECIDED.md) and carries no build label, so the job that can sign never shares a runner with pull request code, and release.yml's verify job, on the build runners, never runs on the runner that signed. tests/test-release-workflow.ps1 holds that this list and records/build-runners.json share no runner. GitHub's runner labels follow this file on main: a push that changes it runs github-admin.yml, and pwsh scripts/deploy/Set-BuildRunners.ps1 asks again (#3107). scripts/deploy/Install-Runner.ps1 registers a runner listed here with the label too, so a reinstall keeps it.
label: thornswood-sign

reach.about: Every host outside GitHub that release.yml's sign steps reach from the signing runner, each with the Azure service tag in Microsoft's published Service Tags file (https://www.microsoft.com/download/details.aspx?id=56519, the Public cloud) whose ranges hold it. scripts/deploy/Install-Runner.ps1 -NetworkOnly lets these tags' ranges through for a runner this file lists, beside GitHub's, and stops before any rule changes when a host answers from an address outside its tag, so a host that moved is said, not blocked. Measured 22 Oct 2026 (#3312): release.yml run 39838728417 stopped at api.nuget.org because runner 3's rules held none of these. Not here, and not measured yet: www.microsoft.com, where the signing chain's certificate and revocation list addresses point (read off the signature of dev launcher 1.2.6.7). It is Akamai, which publishes no ranges. The proof run on 25 Oct 2026 (release.yml run 40243262316, dev 1.2.6.10) signed on runner 3 and was checked on a second runner without it; a stop there later is a finding for #3312, never a resolved address. tests/test-runner-offbox.ps1 holds each host to the file that names it.

hosts.for: Microsoft's signing client, at the URL scripts/release/Setup-ShipMachine.ps1 pins
the token exchange, the job's GitHub OIDC token for an Azure one
the signing service, records/signing/metadata.json's Endpoint; no narrower tag holds it
